Term2: Gram-positive cocci in pairs interim culture results

# INTERIM REPORT OF GRAM-POSITIVE COCCI IN PAIRS

A preliminary report of gram-positive cocci in pairs suggests staphylococci, streptococci, or enterococci. If the patient is severely ill, is likely colonized with resistant organisms, or if staphylococci or enterococci are likely, treat with vancomycin until susceptibility results are known.

Cephalosporins are not active against enterococci or methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.

References

- Medical Letter Choice of Antimicrobials 2010, 8.94
- Sanford keyword: Enterococci
- Sanford keyword: Staphylococci
- Sanford keyword: Streptococci
Therapy:
## Empirical treatment of suspected streptococci

Penicillin G 2 million units IV q4h (Cost $) R

For patients with non-severe penicillin allergy
Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h ($) R

## For severe disease, resistance to beta lactams likely or patient with severe penicillin allergy

Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h (Cost $) R

## Empirical treatment of suspected enterococci

Ampicillin 2 gm IV q4h (Cost $$) R

## For severe disease, resistance to beta-lactams likely or patient with penicillin allergy

Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h (Cost $) R

## Empirical treatment of suspected staphylococci

Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h (Cost $) R
